📺 American Housewife (2016–2021)

American Housewife follows Katie Otto, a confident and outspoken mother of three who struggles to fit in among the wealthy, picture-perfect families of Westport, Connecticut. Unlike the glamorous mothers around her, Katie embraces her imperfections while raising her children alongside her supportive husband, Greg. From hilarious parenting disasters and school drama to awkward neighborhood encounters and unexpected family challenges, Katie refuses to change who she is just to impress others. With sharp humor, relatable family moments, and unforgettable characters, American Housewife explores motherhood, marriage, friendship, and the importance of staying true to yourself.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 7.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Sarah Dunn

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu in the United States. Availability varies by region.
